stories.headline: US and China prepare for AI safety talks
stories.summary: The U.S. and China are preparing their first official bilateral AI-safety dialogue for mid-September. The agenda and participants remain unsettled, but autonomous cyber risks and threat-information sharing are expected topics.

stories.headline: Anthropic IPO launch shifts toward mid-October
stories.summary: Anthropic is expected to begin marketing its IPO in mid-October and list before the U.S. midterms, people familiar with the matter said. The timing and reported potential valuation remain subject to change.

stories.headline: Iran reports US strike on tanker near Kharg Island
stories.summary: Iran's Tasnim news agency said four U.S. missiles hit an Iranian tanker near the Kharg Island export hub. It reported no casualties; neither U.S. Central Command nor Iranian authorities had independently confirmed the account.

stories.headline: Russian drone strikes Ukraine security headquarters
stories.summary: A Russian drone struck Ukraine's SBU security-service headquarters in Kyiv, injuring at least 12 people, Ukrainian officials said. The attack came during a tenth consecutive day of strikes and ahead of renewed diplomacy.

stories.headline: Horse smuggling exposes US screwworm defenses
stories.summary: Reuters found that livestock smuggling across the U.S.-Mexico border bypasses veterinary screening as New World screwworm re-emerges. USDA has not directly linked a U.S. case to smuggling, so the scale of that pathway is uncertain.
